title: tenant.tier_changed
description: Published by accounts when a tenant is promoted or demoted (data model §4's Events table), in the same transaction as the tier change and its tier_changes row. This is the envelope's data field, not the whole envelope (see platform/events.Envelope).

kyc_check_id.description: The KYC check behind the change, when there is one.

changed_by.description: The staff member who made the change; absent when it was automatic.
